title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
abstract: arXiv:2610.38329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. translated_title: 多智能体内核优化循环学习新型AI加速器的案例研究
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型能够为大多数单算子基准测试任务编写正确的CUDA内核，但在面对其架构和编程语言都鲜为人知的加速器时，其准确率会急剧下降。我们提出了一个为此类加速器构建的LLM智能体循环的案例研究。我们的示例是FuriosaAI RNGD NPU，它采用一种新近推出且文档稀缺的Rust DSL进行编程，该循环在共享且稀缺的设备上用12天时间优化了三个Gemma-4-12B解码内核。该循环自行构建目标知识：它编写并校验DSL文档的摘要，通过微基准测试测量芯片性能，记录由编译器导出的合法性规则，并在工具链发生变化时重新审视这些知识，在可能的范围内重新校验规则和测量结果。基于角色的搜索在每内核设计树上探索完整的内核设计方案，并在每个内核的最佳版本中逐步累积已接受的小改动。由于设备时间稀缺且（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个多智能体LLM优化循环，通过自主构建目标知识（文档摘要、微基准测量和编译器合法性规则）来优化文档稀缺的新型NPU上的解码内核，解决大模型在陌生硬件架构上编写内核准确率骤降的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-agent LLM optimization loop that autonomously builds its own target knowledge—documentation summaries, microbenchmark measurements, and compiler-derived legality rules—to optimize decode kernels on a sparsely documented new NPU, addressing the collapse of LLM accuracy on unfamiliar hardware architectures.
